---
title: "read_in_races"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(forcats)

url <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/r/KENDUSKEAG/2025/2015"
kenduskeag <- read_json(url, simplifyVector = TRUE)

kenduskeag <- kenduskeag$results |> as_tibble() |> 
  unnest_wider(rank) |> 
  unnest_longer(paddlers) |>
  unnest_wider(col = c(paddlers, elemVals)) |>
  unnest_wider(`1`, names_sep = "_")

kenduskeag_results <- kenduskeag |> select(year, boatType, bib, classId, place, value, overall, byClass, byYrClass, byYrOver, courseId, displayName)

## renaming columns
kenduskeag_results <- rename(kenduskeag_results, classID = classId, time = value, courseID = courseId)
```

```{r}
## rank/time relationship

kenduskeag_results <- kenduskeag_results |> filter(time != 0) |> filter(courseID != "kenduskeag2019")

ggplot(kenduskeag_results, aes(x = overall, y = time)) +
  geom_point()


```
